hero.headline: Launch Your Own Trading Platform — Without Building It From Scratch.
hero.subhead: A complete, production-grade Stock, Forex & Crypto trading platform you can brand, deploy, and make your own. Full user app. Powerful admin console. Live market data. One clean codebase.
hero.trustLine: Deploys on any host · Web + Mobile · Full source code included · Instant delivery

whatis.text: Zentra is a white-label trading platform — a complete, ready-to-brand web application for Stock, Forex, and Crypto markets, built on a modern TypeScript + React + Node stack. It runs as a single responsive application that renders as a full desktop dashboard on large screens and a native-feeling mobile app on phones — from one codebase, no separate builds. Users get live prices, trading signals, a portfolio, deposits, and withdrawals. Operators get a powerful admin console to run the entire platform.

reviews.name: Marcus Devlin
reviews.text: I'd been quoted $15k+ to build something like this. I bought Zentra, rebranded it over a weekend, and had a working platform live by Monday. The admin console is genuinely powerful — I run deposits, withdrawals and the whole market catalog from there.

reviews.name: Sofia Almeida
reviews.text: Honestly didn't expect the code to be this clean. Deployed it on a $6 VPS with zero database headaches. Support actually replied and walked me through the DNS setup. Worth every dollar.

reviews.name: David Ekwueme
reviews.text: I've bought a lot of 'trading scripts' that were garbage. This is the first one that felt production-grade — real candlestick charts, live prices, proper order flow. I've already recommended it to two of my clients.

reviews.name: Amara Bright
reviews.text: Setup took me an afternoon as a non-dev just by following the guide. Rebranding to my own colors and logo was easy. Half a star off only because I wanted more docs on the stock API — but they helped me sort it over email.

faq.q: Do I get the full source code?
faq.a: Yes — the complete, unencrypted frontend and backend. Yours to modify and rebrand.

faq.q: Do I need to be a developer to deploy it?
faq.a: Not necessarily. If you can follow step-by-step instructions, you can get it live — the guide walks you through every step.

faq.q: Will it run on a cheap server?
faq.a: Yes. It runs as a single Node process with an embedded database, so it works on modest/low-spec servers and budget VPS plans.

faq.q: Can I rebrand it as my own?
faq.a: Absolutely — change the name, logo, colors, and currency from the admin console in minutes.
Crypto (Binance) and forex are live and keyless out of the box; live stocks work with a free API key.

faq.q: What do I get after payment?
faq.a: Instant access to the full source code, admin access, and the deployment guide.

faq.q: Can you help me deploy or build something more advanced?
faq.a: Yes — deployment support is included, and a Custom Build service is available.

faq.q: Is it legal to run a trading platform with this?
faq.a: Zentra is a software product. Operating a trading/brokerage platform is regulated in most regions and may require licensing — you're responsible for compliance. See the disclaimer.
